prediction.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT m."XCL_035", m."XCL_036", mj."XCL_031"
FROM member AS m
INNER JOIN major AS mj ON m."XCL_042" = mj."XCL_030"
WHERE m."XCL_034" IN (
    SELECT a."XCL_002"
    FROM attendance AS a
    WHERE a."XCL_001" IN (
        SELECT a2."XCL_001"
        FROM attendance AS a2
        GROUP BY a2."XCL_001"
        HAVING COUNT(a2."XCL_002") > 20
    )
)
AND m."XCL_034" IN (
    SELECT ex."XCL_022"
    FROM expense AS ex
    WHERE ex."XCL_020" > 100
)

FROM member AS m
INNER JOIN major AS mj ON m."XCL_042" = mj."XCL_030"
WHERE m."XCL_034" IN (
    SELECT a."XCL_002"
    FROM attendance AS a
    WHERE a."XCL_001" IN (
        SELECT a2."XCL_001"
        FROM attendance AS a2
        GROUP BY a2."XCL_001"
        HAVING COUNT(a2."XCL_002") > 20
    )
)
AND m."XCL_034" IN (
    SELECT ex."XCL_022"
    FROM expense AS ex
    WHERE ex."XCL_020" > 100
)

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT m."XCL_035", m."XCL_036", mj."XCL_031"
FROM member AS m
INNER JOIN major AS mj ON m."XCL_042" = mj."XCL_030"
INNER JOIN attendance AS a ON m."XCL_034" = a."XCL_002"
INNER JOIN event AS e ON a."XCL_001" = e."XCL_010"
INNER JOIN expense AS ex ON m."XCL_034" = ex."XCL_022"
WHERE e."XCL_010" IN (SELECT a2."XCL_001" FROM attendance AS a2 GROUP BY a2."XCL_001" HAVING COUNT(a2."XCL_002") > 20)
AND ex."XCL_020" > 100
